accordion.lore.rare: Breathes in so hard between chords that it sucks every napkin off the next table.
accordion.lore.epic: Played so long at the street fair that it stretched to the length of a bus and had to be carried home in sections.
accordion.lore.legendary: Took one breath so deep at the harbour festival that it swallowed the sea breeze, and the sailing race had to wait for the song to end.

x_music_stand.lore.legendary: Stood firm through a gale at an outdoor concert. The orchestra blew away, but the music stayed open at page two.

x_sheet_music.lore.rare: Rearranges its own notes while nobody is looking, so every piece ends as a different song.
x_sheet_music.lore.legendary: Its notes marched off the page one night and formed a choir on the windowsill. They only know scales.

x_music_box_instrument.lore.uncommon: Plays its tune perfectly until somebody listens closely, then hits one wrong note on purpose.
x_music_box_instrument.lore.epic: Was wound a thousand turns too many and played without stopping through a whole wedding, speeches included.
x_music_box_instrument.lore.legendary: Its tiny dancer spun so fast that she took off, flew twice round the room and landed back on top with a curtsy.

x_metronome.lore.uncommon: Stops ticking the moment the teacher leaves the room and starts again when she comes back.
x_metronome.lore.legendary: Kept such strict time that the school choir hiccupped in perfect rhythm, and they performed it as an encore.

x_metronome_clock.lore.legendary: Chimed noon in the middle of a concert so exactly on the beat that the orchestra made it the final note, and now it takes a bow every hour.

x_bongo_drums.lore.epic: Played so fast at a beach party that the sand started bouncing, and every sandcastle shuffled into the sea.
x_bongo_drums.lore.legendary: Played a rhythm so catchy that the waves started breaking on the beat, and the surfers now need a drummer to count them in.
x_bongo_drums.names.legendary: Bop and Bop, the Tide Twins

x_cajon.lore.legendary: Was sat on by a whole school choir at once, and the thump it gave back showed up on the town earthquake meter.

x_conga.lore.epic: Thumped so deeply at a carnival that the manhole covers hopped in time and a sewer worker climbed out to join the band.

x_djembe.lore.rare: Slaps back. Anyone who hits it out of time gets a sharp little sting in the palm.
x_djembe.lore.epic: Drummed so hard at a garden party that every apple fell off the trees at once, and the party became a crumble.
x_djembe.lore.legendary: Played a rhythm so strong that the whole town took it as its heartbeat, and every doctor now hears ba-dum-tak through the stethoscope.

drum.lore.epic: Was hit so hard in a garage solo that the sticks flew out of the window, and the neighbour returned them with a bag of earplugs.

x_timpani.lore.rare: Booms so low that every jelly within a mile wobbles, and the school canteen has given up on pudding.
x_timpani.lore.legendary: Played a finale so huge that the concert hall roof lifted off, took a bow and settled back one seat to the left.

x_toy_drum.lore.legendary: Was banged so hard at a birthday that the candles blew themselves out, and the toddler got the wish.

x_double_bass.lore.epic: Played a note so low at a jazz club that the ice cracked in every glass and the goldfish in the lobby swam in circles.
x_double_bass.lore.legendary: Played such a low note that a whale three seas away answered, and now they are pen pals.

x_electric_bass.lore.rare: Plays so low that the speakers walk across the stage by themselves.
x_electric_bass.lore.epic: Thumped so hard in a garage rehearsal that every paint tin on the shelf popped its lid, and the walls came out purple.

guitar.lore.epic: Played one power chord in a bedroom so loudly that every sock in the drawer stood up.
guitar.lore.legendary: Played a chord so perfect that every guitar in town tuned itself to match, including one that was still a tree.

x_lute.lore.rare: Plays such old songs that anyone listening speaks in thee and thou for the rest of the day.
x_lute.lore.legendary: Played a ballad so old-fashioned that a ruined castle rebuilt itself to listen, then asked it to stay as the house band.

x_mandolin.lore.legendary: Serenaded a lighthouse so sweetly that it now winks at every boat that passes.

x_sitar.lore.uncommon: Has a neck so long that it knocks the lampshade every time it is picked up.
x_sitar.lore.rare: Bends its notes so far that the curtains, the cat and the spaghetti all bend along.
x_sitar.lore.legendary: Played one raga so slowly that a snail crossed the garden and back before the second note.

harp.lore.epic: Played so softly at a wedding that the guests fell asleep, and the bride had to throw the bouquet at a snoring uncle.
harp.lore.legendary: Played a tune by the river so beautiful that the river turned round and flowed backwards for an encore.

microphone.lore.legendary: Picked up a whisper so well that a whole stadium heard the secret, and now everyone knows who ate the last biscuit.

piano.lore.legendary: Fell out of the movers van on a hill, rolled all the way down playing a scale, and stopped at the right house.

x_theremin.lore.rare: Plays a spooky tune whenever anyone yawns near it, so every bedtime comes with music.
x_theremin.lore.legendary: Was played by an octopus at the aquarium, and the eight-armed concert was so spooky that the sharks hid.

x_toy_piano.lore.legendary: Played its twelve keys so fiercely at a concert that the grand piano resigned and became a coffee table.

x_xylophone_toy.lore.rare: Swaps its bars round every night, so every song comes out as a different nursery rhyme.
x_xylophone_toy.lore.epic: Was played so hard at playgroup that a bar flew off, bounced off the goldfish bowl and landed in the teacher's tea.
x_xylophone_toy.lore.legendary: Was played so happily by a toddler that the rainbow outside rearranged its colours to match the bars.

x_bagpipes.lore.rare: Keeps playing for a full minute after the piper stops, and nobody knows how to switch it off.
x_bagpipes.lore.legendary: Was squeezed so hard at the highland games that it puffed up like a balloon and floated the piper across the loch, still playing.

x_bugle.lore.legendary: Played the dinner call so convincingly that a whole herd of cows came in from the field and sat down at the tables.

x_didgeridoo.lore.epic: Droned so deeply in the garden that every worm came up to see what was happening, and the blackbirds threw a party.
x_didgeridoo.lore.legendary: Droned so deep that the bath upstairs turned into a whirlpool, and the rubber duck went round for a week.

x_euphonium.lore.rare: Plays so warmly that ice creams melt in the front row, and the bandstand has a puddle by the second tune.
x_euphonium.lore.legendary: Played so mellow a tune that a grumpy bull in the next field lay down, rolled over and asked for a tummy rub.

x_harmonica_instrument.lore.rare: Plays such sad blues that the milk in the fridge goes sour out of sympathy.
x_harmonica_instrument.lore.legendary: Played a blues so lonely that a passing train stopped, reversed and gave it a lift home.

x_harmonica_small.lore.rare: Is so small that it gets sneezed out of a pocket by accident, playing a chord on the way.
x_harmonica_small.lore.epic: Fell down a drain and played a tune every time the wind blew, so the whole street danced round the drain for a week.
x_harmonica_small.lore.legendary: Played a chord so huge from inside a pocket that the trousers did a little dance on their own.

x_kazoo.lore.rare: Turns any speech into a buzz, so the head teacher's announcements sound like a very cross bee.
x_kazoo.lore.legendary: Buzzed so convincingly that a whole hive of bees moved in and now hums the harmony.

x_melodica.lore.rare: Blows back. Anyone who puffs too hard gets a little squeak of air right up the nose.
x_melodica.lore.legendary: Played the piano part and the trumpet part at once so well that the real piano and trumpet left together in a huff.

x_piccolo.lore.legendary: Hit a note so high that every bat in town flew in to complain, and now it gives them singing lessons.

x_recorder.lore.legendary: Played one song perfectly in tune, and the music teacher was so shocked that she has been on holiday ever since.

x_sousaphone.lore.rare: Has a bell so big that it catches rain, leaves and once a small football, and toots them all back out.
x_sousaphone.lore.legendary: Oompahed so deeply that a family of pigeons moved into its bell and now come out to bow at the end of every march.

trumpet.lore.legendary: Blew a fanfare so grand that every pigeon in the square landed in rows and saluted.

violin.lore.rare: Plays a high note so sharp that it pops every soap bubble in the room.
violin.lore.legendary: Played a tune so sad that the onions in the kitchen stopped making people cry, out of respect.

x_banana_bunch.lore.rare: Makes every lunchbox it touches taste of banana, the cheese sandwiches included.
x_banana_bunch.lore.epic: Was left in a hot car and came out as banana bread on the back seat.
x_banana_bunch.lore.legendary: Grows one extra banana every time it is counted, and the fruit bowl is now a fruit wardrobe.

x_banana_peel.lore.legendary: Sent a whole marathon sliding past the finish line, and the slowest runner won by standing still.

x_banana_split.lore.rare: Splits in two whenever two people reach for it, and each half insists it is the bigger one.
x_banana_split.lore.epic: Was built so long at an ice-cream parlour that it reached the door, and customers had to step over the cherry.
x_banana_split.lore.legendary: Was so cold that the whole beach got brain freeze at once, and the heatwave was called off.

x_bell.lore.rare: Rings by itself whenever someone tells a fib, which has made birthdays very awkward.
x_bell.lore.legendary: Rang at a fib told on the far side of town, so loudly that the fibber owned up before the echo stopped.

x_castanets.lore.rare: Clacks so fast that nearby teeth start chattering along, even on a hot day.

x_church_bell.lore.uncommon: Rings so early on a Saturday that the whole village wakes up and blames the cockerel.
x_church_bell.lore.epic: Swung so hard on fete day that the tower swayed and the weathervane turned to face the cake stall.

x_cowbell.lore.rare: Clangs so loudly that the cow cannot hear the farmer, and pretends it never could.
x_cowbell.lore.legendary: Clanged so bossily that the whole herd made it head cow, and it now gets the first patch of clover.

x_cymbal.lore.rare: Shimmers so long after one crash that the next song has to start in its key.
x_cymbal.lore.legendary: Crashed so hard that it split a raincloud in two, and the concert had sunshine on one side and drizzle on the other.

x_guitar_pick.lore.legendary: Hid so well that it was found inside a sealed guitar, a locked safe and a boiled egg.

x_handbell.lore.rare: Rings whenever anyone in the class is daydreaming, which makes Friday afternoons very noisy.
x_handbell.lore.legendary: Rang the end of break so firmly that the whole playground froze mid-game, football included, until it was put away.

x_hi_hat.lore.rare: Snaps shut on anything left between its cymbals, including a drummer's sandwich and once a tie.
x_hi_hat.lore.legendary: Played itself so well that the drummer went on holiday, and nobody noticed for three tours.

x_plantain_chips.lore.uncommon: Snaps in half the moment it touches the dip, every single time.
x_plantain_chips.lore.rare: Breaks into so many salty crumbs that the sofa, the bed and the dog are all seasoned by bedtime.
x_plantain_chips.lore.legendary: Crunched so loudly in a library that every book fell off the shelves, in alphabetical order.

x_rain_stick.lore.rare: Patters so softly that anyone listening falls asleep in under a minute, including whoever is holding it.
x_rain_stick.lore.epic: Got wedged in a car roof rack, and the car drove through town sounding like its own private storm.

x_shaker.lore.rare: Shakes itself whenever it hears music, so every advert on the telly comes with percussion.
x_shaker.lore.legendary: Was shaken so hard that its beads burst out, bounced down the street and formed their own tiny band.

x_singing_bowl.lore.uncommon: Gets used as a fruit bowl by visitors, then hums loudly the moment anyone takes an apple.
x_singing_bowl.lore.legendary: Hummed so calmly that the traffic outside slowed to walking pace, and nobody minded being late.

x_triangle.lore.rare: Tings so brightly that every spoon in the drawer rings back, always on the wrong beat.
x_triangle.lore.legendary: Went ting once so perfectly that the conductor put down the baton, and the triangle has been conducting ever since.

x_wind_chime.lore.rare: Jangles at the faintest breath, so even a sneeze in the next garden sets it off.
x_wind_chime.lore.legendary: Caught a breeze so mighty that it played the whole storm like a song, and the weather forecast now comes with sheet music.

xylophone.lore.legendary: Played a scale so fast that the notes arrived before the mallets hit them, and the audience clapped before it began.
